ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics dashboard tailored for university administrators in Amherst to forecast campus safety incidents, resource bottlenecks, and student support demand using historical campus data and Poisson regression.
ideas.title: CampusPulse AI: Student Incident and Resource Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a problem university judges and local organizers feel directly, echoing the predictive accuracy and backtesting approach seen in winning forecasting models.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace and USDC escrow system designed specifically to streamline budgeting and reimbursements for student organizations at UMass Amherst.
ideas.title: PioneerPay: Autonomous Club Funding & Escrow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines autonomous agent mechanics with clear financial utility, following the success formula of decentralized escrow marketplace applications.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutritional assistant that integrates directly with UMass Dining menus to generate personalized meal plans, track micronutrients, and accommodate severe dietary restrictions for students.
ideas.title: Amherst Dining NutriGuide AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a hyper-local problem using highly practical wellness AI technology, mirroring the rapid success of localized student nutrition apps.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent routing and matching app that connects senior citizens in the Pioneer Valley with student volunteer drivers for grocery runs and medical appointments.
ideas.title: ValleyConnect Senior Shuttle
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a clear, quantified social impact for the local Amherst community, matching the criteria that win social good hackathon tracks.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool to track green space changes, construction runoff, and environmental compliance across the UMass Amherst campus footprint.
ideas.title: EcoMonitor UMass: Satellite Land Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced geospatial AI for measurable environmental monitoring, following the architectural patterns of successful industrial compliance tools.
